# Workspace Guide

## Project

- Desktop-first Ukrainian air-raid alert map built with React, TypeScript, and Vite.
- Keep the map, region list, filters, loading state, connection status, and fetch time synchronized.
- Use `npm.cmd run dev` for local testing, `npm.cmd run lint` for linting, and `npm.cmd run build` for production validation.

## Alert Data

- The only data source is the official UkraineAlarm API v3 (`https://api.ukrainealarm.com/api/v3/alerts`), authenticated with the `authorization` header and the `UKRAINE_ALARM_TOKEN` server secret. `shared/ukraine-alarm-alerts.mjs` is the single normalizer; `shared/ukraine-alarm-regions.mjs` is generated by `npm run sync:alarm-regions` and maps `regionId` to its oblast.
- The source allows one request per minute per key. Only `server/alerts-feed.mjs` and `scripts/publish-ukraine-alarm-feed.mjs` call it: the backend caches for 60 seconds and serves the last successful feed for up to 10 minutes on errors, while `alerts-feed.yml` publishes a snapshot every 5 minutes. Never poll the source from the browser.
- Render source `red` and `yellow` levels distinctly on the map, legend, region list, selected region, banner, CSV and notifications; an unrecognized or missing level is always shown as red, never as safe.
- Normalize and deduplicate source data server-side, including parent-oblast mapping; never expose or copy authorization tokens into browser code or GitHub repository variables. Keep the key in `.env` (gitignored) and in the Actions `secrets.UKRAINE_ALARM_TOKEN`.
- Do not substitute mock statuses for source data. The `Автооновлення` mode polls its feed every 60 seconds; preserve and label the last successful data when offline.
- The `Наживо` mode embeds the official map and its own push connection; do not copy or expose credentials from that page.
- Keep long-running administrative notices in occupied territory (six hours and longer) visually distinct from current threats and exclude them from current-threat totals.
- Do not show target coordinates or imply that absent map markers mean safety.
- Keep favorites, user notification settings, activity history, filters, and CSV export synchronized with the selected source data.
- GitHub Pages works with no backend: it reads the `feed` branch snapshot over `raw.githubusercontent.com`. Set the `ALERTS_API_URL` repository variable only to add the one-minute backend path; the workflow needs the `UKRAINE_ALARM_TOKEN` Actions secret, and both feeds expose only sanitized public alert data.
- Treat this as informational only, never as a replacement for official alerts or local authority instructions.

## Map Attribution

- Map geometry comes from `@svg-maps/ukraine`, derived from MapSVG under CC BY 4.0.
- Retain links to MapSVG and the CC BY 4.0 license in the interface and documentation.
- Keep the visible UkraineAlarm credit and link in the interface and documentation.
